szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing teammates in Perplexity. Teammates take on jobs, and work proactively using your Computer tasks, skills, memory, and connected tools.

They monitor ongoing work and act when something changes, without needing a new prompt. Each teammate remembers past work, applies your feedback to future tasks, and can collaborate with other teammates or message coworkers in Slack.

Each teammate runs in its own isolated environment and follows Computer’s existing tool and Project permissions. You can review its work, take over the desktop, or redirect it as it works.

Available now for Max subscribers on the web.

Get started: https://lnkd.in/eXrga4_5
